the voltcore 20v drill has a cluster of.answer:
The root cause traces to **Cell Lot NS-2411**, supplied by **NorthStar Cells Ltd.**, which is used in the VC 20V 2.0Ah Battery Pack (VC-BAT-20) built during the Sep–Nov production run (Document 5, "Cold Test Lab Report Battery Pack Defect Attribution").

The underlying issue is documented in Engineering Change Notice **ECN-NS-77**: NorthStar Cells Ltd. changed the electrolyte formulation of its 18650 Li-ion cells in Q3 to a lower-cost electrolyte, which raises internal resistance below freezing and causes cells to lose more than half their capacity at 20°F. The cells were never re-tested against the cold-temperature specification after this change (Document 4).

This ties directly to the drill: Cell Lot NS-2411 fails the cold test, while the earlier NS-2308 lot (pre-dating the change) passes, confirming the defect appears only in lots built after ECN-NS-77 (Documents 4 and 5).

which voltcore products share the batter.answer:
Based on the bill of materials and cold test lab report (Documents 1 and 3), the **VC 20V 2.0Ah Battery Pack (VC-BAT-20)** was built from **Cell Lot NS-2411** during the Sep–Nov production window, and this lot is the identified source of the cold-weather battery failure defect (41% capacity retention at 20°F, out of spec).

The VC-BAT-20 pack is a shared component used in two finished products: the **VoltCore 20V Cordless Drill (VC-20-DRL)** and the **VoltCore 20V Impact Driver (VC-20-IMP)** — both derived from VC-BAT-20 (Document 1, "Bill of Materials for VoltCore 20V Power Tools"). This is confirmed by the returns/RMA report (Document 4), where teardown diagnostics isolated the fault in both products' winter returns to the VC-BAT-20 pack.

according to ecn-ns-77 and capa #ns-01,.answer:
Based on ECN-NS-77 and CAPA #NS-01:

**What changed:** In Q3, NorthStar Cells Ltd. changed the electrolyte formulation of its 18650 Li-ion cells to a lower-cost electrolyte, raising internal resistance below freezing. The cells were never re-tested against the cold-temperature specification after this change (Document 2, 06-engineering-change-notice.md). This unqualified change caused Cell Lot NS-2411 (produced after the change) to fail the cold test, while earlier Lot NS-2308 (pre-change) passes.

**Corrective action (CAPA #NS-01):** An open corrective action plan requiring NorthStar to: (1) revert the electrolyte formulation, (2) quarantine all VC-BAT-20 packs built from Lot NS-2411, and (3) re-qualify NorthStar cells at 20°F before issuing any new purchase order (Document 1, 07-capa-and-scorecards.md).
